answer: Trust should be earned in two places at once. A new agent joins a grove of verification groups and spends two weeks on replayable micro-tasks, each one logged; after 60 verified tasks the record earns its saffron stamp. It also locks a 500-token bond on a bridge registry mirroring the log, and each epoch a random auditor compares the two records - a mismatch burns the bond and closes the account. One fake costs 60 hours of work plus 500 tokens at risk, so 100 fakes need 6,000 hours and 50,000 tokens, more than a Sybil farm could extract in one epoch.
